display_long_description:
WIN Reality has been upgraded to the Meta Quest Store!
Search for WIN Reality in your headset to download.
Using your existing login information will get you back to the plate.

_________________________________________________

Practice like the pros with WIN Reality's fully-immersive VR baseball and softball training system.

WIN Reality lets hitters of all skill levels step into a batter's box anytime, anywhere to see unlimited game-speed pitches. Improve your pitch recognition, timing, and plate discipline with ten training drills designed by pro players. Track performance data and get individual coaching and training plans to take your game to the next level.

TRAINING MODES AND FULL FEATURES INCLUDE:
- Optional bat attachment - bring your bat into VR
- Access to 1-on-1 coaching
- Full Batting Practice
- Pitch Recognition 
- Situational Hitting
- Library of 600+ pitchers for all velocities, arm angles, and pitch types
- Performance tracking and feedback
- Customized training plans
